description.zh:
钉钉机器人通知编号。多个编号可采用英文半角逗号隔开。
>调用[DescribeDingTalk](~~DescribeDingTalk~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The notification IDs of DingTalk chatbots. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

>  You can call the [DescribeDingTalk](~~DescribeDingTalk~~) operation to query the notification IDs.

The notification status of a DingTalk chatbot. Valid values:

*   **0**: disabled
*   **1**: enabled

title.zh: 修改钉钉机器人通知状态

descriptions.zh: 仅支持云安全中心企业版用户调用该接口。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation only if you use Security Center Enterprise.
